author: Holandre, 1825
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 여름철새 수만 마리 · 텃새 수백 마리
summary: 비교적 흔한 여름철새이며 일부는 텃새로 머문다. 낙엽활엽수림과 잡목림에 살며, 주로 새벽과 늦은 밤에 '히이~, 호오~' 하는 가는 피리 같은 소리를 낸다. 큰키나무 가지 위에 이끼를 많이 쓰고 마른 가지와 낙엽을 조금 섞어 밥그릇 모양 둥지를 짓고, 4~7월에 알을 4~5개 낳는다. 한국, 일본, 중국 동북부, 우수리, 시베리아 남부에서 번식하고 겨울에는 중국 남부, 대만, 필리핀, 동남아시아 등지로 내려간다.

art.subject: White's Thrush (Zoothera aurea), adult (sexes alike), as seen in Korean forest from April to September: upperparts golden olive-brown, every feather tipped with a black crescent, giving a boldly scaled look; face pale buff-white with a dark crescent on the rear ear coverts; throat white; breast and flanks white to buffy-white, densely marked with black crescentic scales; belly centre and undertail coverts white; tail olive-brown with dark outer feathers tipped white. Bill dark brown with a paler base to the lower mandible. Large dark eye. Pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch at dawn, singing
art.scene: Korean deciduous broadleaf forest at dawn in early summer; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a branch: golden olive-brown upperparts boldly scaled with black crescents, white throat, white breast and belly densely scaled black, dark crescent on the cheek, dark-edged tail with white tips, pinkish legs
adult in flight seen from below, head, body and tail in one line: broad black-and-white bands across the underwing, scaled white underparts, white tail corners
art.build: Large, bulky thrush, about 29.5cm, a little longer than a Brown-eared Bulbul and much heavier; large rounded head, big dark eye, plump body. Bill fairly long and strong, slightly shorter than the head. Legs long and sturdy, pinkish-flesh. Tail medium length, square. In flight a striking underwing with broad black and white bands. Shy; feeds on the forest floor with slow, rocking steps.
avoid: Do not paint round spots like a Song Thrush; the markings are black crescents (scales).
Do not paint orange or rufous on the breast or flanks.
Do not paint a plain, unmarked back; every upperpart feather is black-tipped.
Do not paint a yellow bill or dark legs.
